title: Nametag flicker: camera shift or pull-back?
intro: Co-op starts by itself. Stand still near the pawns. You'll change two sliders under Camera Distance in the REFramework menu and tell me if the flicker stays.

steps.text: Hands off - starting co-op. Stand near the pawns.
Camera Distance menu: note 'Max shift (m)' and 'Max pull back (m)', then set Max shift to 0 (Ctrl+click the slider to type). Close the menu, press End
A) Shift 0, pull-back normal - do the nametags flicker? Then press End
Set Max shift back to what it was, set Max pull back to 0. Close the menu, press End
B) Pull-back 0, shift normal - do they flicker? Then press End
Put Max pull back back to what it was. Press End
